paragraphs.text: Calamity is a horse mount who was seen on Thunder Junction after the Omenpaths opened.

Calamity is a horse mount with black skin, and flaming hoofs and tail. It appears to be ridden by a humanoid elemental . It is unknown if it originated from Thunder Junction or arrived from an Omenpath.
Calamity's name may be a reference to the American frontier sharpshooter Calamity Jane .
